summary: Review todo.txt items and propose approval-gated, privacy-safe transformations into existing or new OpenSpec changes.

outcomes: Classify todo.txt items before deciding whether they belong in OpenSpec.
Propose zero-to-many and many-to-many transformations without losing operational or private work.

scenarios.title: Review a mixed todo queue
scenarios.prompt: Use $promote-todo-to-openspec to classify this todo.txt and propose separate transformations for my approval before changing files.
scenarios.outcome: Every item is accounted for while operational, unclear, private, and sensitive work remains outside shared specifications.

scenarios.title: Consolidate overlapping product intent
scenarios.prompt: Use $promote-todo-to-openspec to map these overlapping todo.txt entries into existing or new OpenSpec changes without assuming one-to-one promotion.
scenarios.outcome: A coverage ledger presents merge, split, relocation, and preservation choices that can be accepted independently.
